CheckTitle: Ensure Assignments of Substantial Access to Business Users Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion Applications Security Console / Audit Reports (IT Security Manager)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Assignments of privileges that expose employee, payroll, supplier, customer or bank data should be monitored.
Risk: Such privileges let users view sensitive data without oversight.
AuditProcedure: Identify roles with sensitive privileges in the Security Console and inspect assignments.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4079, 4080, 6681, 9800-9805.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments and confirm data-handling compliance.
